insights.summary: Finance and procurement push back on paying separately for add-ons (PreSense, QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes) at renewal.
insights.quote: So we pay for call tracking, and then Signal AI sits on top as its own add-on, and then PreSense is another add-on, and then the QM seats are per seat, and now the AI Voice Agent minutes are separate again.

insights.summary: Customer links "add-on pricing friction at renewal" to the renewal decision.
insights.quote: And I'll be honest, if the add-on pricing keeps feeling like nickel and diming, we're going to have to look around before we commit.
